create-online-store.introTitle: How do you create an online store yourself?
intro: Creating an online store takes four steps: claim your store's link, pick a template, add your products, then turn on payments and shipping and publish. On Tallaby every step happens in your dashboard, with no developer and no code.

An online store is a website that shows your products with their photos and prices and takes orders at any time. Many sellers in Egypt start on Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, but orders get lost in messages. A store gives you one link with your brand's name, a page for each product that can show up on Google, and a dashboard for orders, shipping and payments.
You can get through the steps in a day, then publish when you're ready. If you need a hand, message us on WhatsApp.

create-online-store.faqTitle: Questions about the steps to create an online store

faq.q: How do I create an online store step by step?
faq.a: Sign up and claim your store's link, pick a template, add your products, turn on payments and shipping, then publish. Every step happens in your dashboard.

faq.q: How long does it take to create an online store on Tallaby?
faq.a: You can sign up, pick a template and add your products in a day, then publish when you're ready.

faq.q: Is creating a store free?
faq.a: Creating a store is free. The Free plan has no monthly subscription, you don't need a credit card to sign up, and you pay {orderFee} per order. Your store takes orders from day one; make a first top-up from {topUpMin} within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders and send campaigns. Order emails to your customers need the Order Notifications app, whose cost you see in your dashboard before you turn it on.

faq.q: Do I need a developer or technical experience?
faq.a: No. Every step happens visually in your dashboard, from picking a template to connecting payment and shipping.

faq.q: Can I use my own domain?
faq.a: Yes. Your store starts on a free link like yourbrand.tallaby.com, and you can connect a domain you own to your main store by adding its DNS records.

faq.q: How do I ship orders?
faq.a: Tallaby doesn't deliver orders itself. Connect your Bosta account and issue waybills from your dashboard, download the Wassalha sheet or use your own riders, and set shipping rates by area.

faq.q: Can I move my products from another store or page?
faq.a: Yes. Import your products from an Excel file, a product link or Shopify.

The two plans differ in fees, AI credits and campaign emails, not in the tools you sell with.
As your orders grow, Pro at {pro} a month with no order fees may cost you less. Check it with the store cost calculator before you decide.

free-online-store.faqTitle: Questions about a free online store

faq.q: Is the store free forever?
faq.a: The Free plan has no monthly fee, and we don't ask for a credit card. It isn't cost-free, though: you pay {orderFee} per order, and you need a first wallet top-up from {topUpMin} within {days} days or when your first order arrives, whichever comes first, to keep seeing new orders and send campaigns.

faq.q: What's the difference between Free and Pro?
faq.a: On Free you pay {orderFee} per order and no monthly fee. On Pro you pay {pro} a month and no order fees, with more AI credits and campaign emails. Which costs less depends on how many orders you get.

faq.q: Do I need a credit card to sign up?
faq.a: No. Sign up with email or a Google account, and top up your wallet later in EGP.
faq.aOutsideEgypt: No. Sign up with email or a Google account, and top up your wallet later by card in USD.

faq.q: Can I open a free online store in Egypt and sell with cash on delivery?
faq.a: Yes. Cash on delivery is on in every store from the start, you set shipping prices by governorate or area, and you can connect your Bosta account whenever you like.

faq.q: Do apps cost extra?
faq.a: Some apps have a cost, like the Order Notifications app that emails your customers about their orders. You see each app's cost in your dashboard before you turn it on.

faq.q: Does Tallaby take a share of my sales?
faq.a: No. The Free plan's fee is a fixed amount per order, not a share of its value. If you connect Paymob or Kashier, your payment provider sets its own card fees.

online-store-egypt.introTitle: Why build your online store in Egypt on Tallaby?
intro: An ecommerce platform for Egypt needs more than a nice website. Most customers pay on delivery, shipping costs differ from one governorate to the next, and sellers want card payments to land in their own account. Tallaby is an Egyptian platform built around those details.

Cash on delivery is on in every store, and you set shipping prices for each governorate or area, with free shipping over an amount you choose. Connect your Bosta account to send orders and print waybills, or use your own riders. For card payments, connect your own Paymob or Kashier account and the money goes to you.
Tallaby doesn't deliver orders and doesn't hold your sales money. You choose your shipping company and payment provider; we give you the store and the dashboard that brings them together.

faq.a: Yes. The Free plan has no monthly fee, and you pay {orderFee} per order. You top up your wallet in EGP, from {topUpMin}.

faq.q: Does Tallaby deliver orders to customers?
faq.a: No. Tallaby doesn't deliver orders itself. Connect your Bosta account, download the Wassalha sheet for Egypt Post, or use your own riders.

faq.q: How do I get paid for card orders?

faq.a: Yes. A customer can transfer straight to your account with InstaPay or a wallet, then upload a screenshot of the transfer with the order.

faq.q: Can I sell to every governorate?
faq.a: Yes. You choose the governorates and areas you ship to and the price of each, and the customer sees the shipping cost before ordering.

cash-on-delivery-store.introTitle: Why does your store need cash on delivery?
intro: Cash on delivery is how most shoppers in Egypt prefer to pay, because they see the product before paying. So every online store on Tallaby takes cash on delivery from the start, with nothing to set up.

Cash on delivery has a cost, though: an order refused at the door means shipping both ways. So your dashboard has a button that opens WhatsApp with a ready confirmation message, a warning on numbers that refused earlier orders, number blocking, and an automatic limit on repeat orders from the same number.
You can turn cash on delivery off for a shipping zone, and offer card payment through your own Paymob or Kashier account, or InstaPay transfers.

cash-on-delivery-store.faqTitle: Questions about a cash on delivery store

faq.q: Is cash on delivery on in every store?
faq.a: Yes. Every new store takes cash on delivery from the start. You can turn it off for a shipping zone, or turn it off entirely once another payment method is on.

faq.q: How do I confirm cash on delivery orders?
faq.a: Each new order has an "Ask to confirm" button that opens WhatsApp to the customer with a ready message. When they reply, press "Confirm order". Orders still unconfirmed after 24 hours are highlighted.

faq.q: Does Tallaby send WhatsApp messages automatically?
faq.a: No. You send the message from your phone in one tap; the text is ready and you can edit it for each store.

faq.q: How do I cut fake orders?
faq.a: Block numbers that keep refusing, watch for the "refused earlier orders" warning on an order, and confirm before you ship. The platform also limits repeat orders from the same number within a short time.

faq.q: Who collects the cash from the customer?
faq.a: Your shipping company or your rider. With Bosta, you send the amount to collect with the shipment. Tallaby doesn't deliver orders or collect money.

faq.q: Can I offer card payment too?
faq.a: Yes. Connect your own Paymob or Kashier account, and card payment shows next to cash on delivery.
